title: 英伟达拟募资5000亿美元，华尔街巨头竞相参与
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Well, to source 500 billion dollars is to go to those big Wall Street firms, investment managers, and say, find us the capital, find the investors.
segments.zh: 要筹集5000亿美元，就得去找华尔街的大公司、**管理机构，让他们帮忙找资金、找市场参与者。

segments.en: And we don't know the profile of the investors yet. But the Pitch Room video is to take Nvidia's compute platform, literally rows and rows of servers, and make them an
segments.zh: 目前还不清楚市场参与者的构成。但Pitch Room视频展示了英伟达的计算平台，一排排服务器，将其打造成一个

segments.en: investable infrastructure asset class of their own.
segments.zh: 可**的基础设施资产类别。

segments.en: So those six groups from Wall Street go out, find the funds, or the investors, then what Bloomberg is reporting is,
segments.zh: 那六个华尔街团队出去找资金或市场参与者，然后据彭博报道，

segments.en: you take a special purpose vehicle, some kind of entity, that entities the one that raises the money, pays for the Nvidia compute,
segments.zh: 设立一个特殊目的载体，某种实体，由该实体筹集资金，支付英伟达的计算设备费用，

segments.en: the compute acts as collateral, and then you rent it out to an Nvidia customer, and it literally greases the wheels.
segments.zh: 计算设备作为抵押品，然后租给英伟达的客户，这确实能起到润滑作用。

segments.en: There's no barrier to somebody being able to finance the project.
segments.zh: 这样，为项目融资就没有障碍了。

segments.en: You know what I have to admit? From a banker's perspective, that's genius, I think, I think. It's kind of interesting.
segments.zh: 你知道吗？从银行家的角度看，这真是天才之举，我觉得挺有意思的。

segments.en: Ed, just to you and to others out there, does that raise the old circular, financing, interest kind of concern out there?
segments.zh: Ed，想问你和其他人，这是否会引发那种循环融资、利息方面的担忧？

segments.en: Well, what Nvidia would say is that in the first instance, this is third party capital. Again, the six Wall Street firms go out and source the capital from investors, and we don't have a good sense of
segments.zh: 英伟达可能会说，首先，这是第三方资本。那六家华尔街公司会去市场参与者那里筹集资金，我们目前还不清楚

segments.en: whether that's pension funds or sovereign wealth funds, but the money does not come from Nvidia, and so there's a degree of separation
segments.zh: 无论是养老基金还是主权财富基金，资金并非来自英伟达，因此存在一定程度的隔离

segments.en: from the idea that Nvidia is literally financing its own customer's purchases of the gear, but it is one of a multifaceted concern,
segments.zh: 这不同于英伟达直接资助客户购买设备的想法，但这是多方面担忧之一
